page_title: MNU 2-0 AST | Manchester Utd v Aston Villa 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Chidozie Obi (Manchester United), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
90+8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+8' Robin Olsen pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop an accurate header from the corner kick by Jonny Evans (Manchester United) going inside the left-hand post. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+7' It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
90+7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
90+4' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Casemiro (Manchester United).
90+4' The foul by Casemiro (Manchester United) was seen by Thomas Bramall who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

90+3' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the left side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and the keeper pulls off an easy save.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) decided to try his luck with a first-time shot. He didn't hit the ball properly and the shot goes way over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
87' 2 - 0 Goal! Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Robin Olsen into middle of the goal.
87' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

86' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Bramall stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Manchester Utd.
84' Morgan Rogers will be replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
83' Here is a change. Boubacar Kamara is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
83' POST! Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
82' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
81' Substitution. Chidozie Obi (Manchester United) on for Rasmus Hojlund.
80' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Bramall ignores the protests.
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Bruno Fernandes and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
76' The goal by Aston Villa won’t count as referee Thomas Bramall disallows the goal on the advice of the video assistant referee.
73' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Pau Torres (Aston Villa) gets booked.
72' Aston Villa score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
72' Goal disallowed! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) scores but Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.

70' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it curls just wide of the right post.
66' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
66' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Mason Mount and he is replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
66' That will be all from Ayden Heaven who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
65' The ball is cleared after Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
63' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
63' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Amadou Onana will be replaced by Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
62' John McGinn comes off the pitch to be replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
62' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
61' Casemiro (Manchester United) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.

59' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Robin Olsen makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
58' The resulting corner, taken by John McGinn (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.
58' A cross into the box from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is cleared. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) sprays a pass out to Rasmus Hojlund, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
57' A pass by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
55' Casemiro (Manchester United) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post.
49' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
49' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
49' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ruben Amorim probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). He is replaced by Kobbie Mainoo.
46' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
45+4' Unai Emery is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Marco Asensio will be replaced by Robin Olsen (Aston Villa).
45+1' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) was probably a bit loose with his words to Thomas Bramall, who decides to show him a yellow.
45+1' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is ordered to leave the field of play by the referee after receiving a red card!
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
41' The corner from John McGinn (Aston Villa) is hurriedly cleared.

41' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' John McGinn (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
40' Total attempts – 8:1.
37' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
36' A clumsy foul by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle.
33' Casemiro (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.

33' Good defending. Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) tries to find Rasmus Hojlund inside the box, but the pass is cut out. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' The linesman raises his flag. Casemiro (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
29' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a precise pass and goes for goal, but his effort crashes against the left post!
29' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
21' The linesman signals that Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
20' Ruben Amorim is forced to make a change. Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Diogo Dalot.
17' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) unleashed a stunning snap shot! Unfortunately for him, his effort went a whisker wide of the left post.
12' Mason Mount (Manchester United) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
10' Casemiro (Manchester United) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Emiliano Martinez gets down to his right to keep it out.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
6' Mason Mount (Manchester United) attacks the lofted ball and directs a header towards the left side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez is well positioned and makes the save.
5' Mason Mount (Manchester United) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez made an easy save.
4' Mason Mount (Manchester United) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Thomas Bramall signals.
3' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) tries to find Noussair Mazraoui, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Thomas Bramall was nominated as the referee for this game.
